svg.aria-label: One request to the model has three parts: the instructions in the system field, the same bytes every request; the conversation so far, sent as it stands and growing, which opens with your first prompt and then six facts, each a user message of its own (where you are working, skills you can open, environment, what is answering, what you have, permissions), told once and then again as a short change note when one changes, and all six restated after a compaction, followed by the model's answers, tool calls and results and later prompts; and one schema for each tool advertised, sent every request.
